source_caption:
Christopher Lloyd performed Judge Doom in Who Framed Roger Rabbit almost entirely without the animated characters present, acting opposite stand-ins and imagining the cartoon world—making his performance even more impressive and unsettling.

Who Framed Roger Rabbit (1988), directed by Robert Zemeckis, starring Bob Hoskins, Christopher Lloyd, Joanna Cassidy. A groundbreaking blend of live-action and animation that follows a detective drawn into a chaotic mystery where cartoon characters and humans collide.

source_details.title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit
source_details.synopsis: Who Framed Roger Rabbit is a 1988 American fantasy comedy film directed by Robert Zemeckis from a screenplay written by Jeffrey Price and Peter S. Seaman. The film, which combines live-action and animation, is loosely based on Gary K. Wolf's novel Who Censored Roger Rabbit? The film stars Bob Hoskins, Christopher Lloyd, Stubby Kaye and Joanna Cassidy, with Charles Fleischer providing the voice of the title character.
